name: Thue
summary: John Colagioia's 2000 string-rewriting language based on semi-Thue systems with nondeterministic rule application.

level_notes.1: Colagioia's original documentation survives only in archives; esolangs.org carries the specification.
level_notes.0: No verified implementation repository linked; implementations are listed on the esolangs.org page.
level_notes.2: Little secondary literature exists beyond the wiki/encyclopedia entries.
